formMetadata.purpose: Applicant files to adjust status to lawful permanent resident while remaining in the US.
formMetadata.situations: Immediate relatives of US citizens, employment-based preference immigrants, diversity visa winners, and others with an immediately available visa number who are physically present in the US.
formMetadata.use-cases: Spouse of US citizen married in the US; beneficiary of approved I-140 with current priority date; asylee or refugee adjusting after one year.
formMetadata.filing-context: Filed with USCIS along with I-864, I-693, I-131, and I-765 as a package. No consular processing.
formMetadata.parties-involved: Applicant: the foreign national seeking permanent residence. Preparer: attorney or accredited representative who completed the form on the applicant's behalf.

fields.description: Applicant's legal family name (last name) exactly as it appears on their passport or travel document.
fields.notes: Use passport spelling. Do not abbreviate or translate. All caps if the form prints in uppercase.

fields.description: Applicant's legal given name (first name) as it appears on their passport.
fields.notes: Use passport spelling. Single first name only — do not include middle name here.
